Brief: Tell me about the Hubble Space Telescope and what it has discovered. — about Impact on astronomy

Kept:
1. As of 2025, over 22,000 papers based on Hubble data have been published in peer-reviewed journals, and countless more have appeared in conference proceedings.
2. On average, a paper based on Hubble data receives about twice as many citations as papers based on non-Hubble data.
3. Of the 200 papers published each year that receive the most citations, about 10% are based on Hubble data.
